arxiv-1412-2268.title: Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation for Device-to-Device Underlay Communication
arxiv-1412-2268.creator: Feiran Wang, Chen Xu, Lingyang Song, and Zhu Han
arxiv-1412-2268.description: Abstract Device-to-device (D2D) communication underlaying cellular networks is expected to bring significant benefits for utilizing resources, improving user throughput and extending battery life of user equipments. However, the allocation of radio and power resources to D2D communication needs elaborate coordination, as D2D communication can cause interference to cellular communication.

arxiv-1906-11574.title: New exact analytical results for two quasiparticle excitation in the fractional quantum Hall effect
arxiv-1906-11574.creator: Z. Bentalha
arxiv-1906-11574.description: Abstract In this work, two quasiparticle excitation energies per particle are calculated analytically for systems with up to N = 7 N=7 electrons in both Laughlin and composite fermions (CF) theories by considering the full jellium potential which consists of three parts, the electron-electron, electron-background, and background-background Coulomb interactions.

arxiv-2106-09691.title: Interactive Change Point Detection using optimisation approach and Bayesian statistics applied to real world applications
arxiv-2106-09691.creator: R. Gedda, L. Beilina, R. Tan
arxiv-2106-09691.description: Abstract Change point detection becomes more and more important as datasets increase in size, where unsupervised detection algorithms can help users process data. To detect change points, a number of unsupervised algorithms have been developed which are based on different principles. One approach is to define an optimisation problem and minimise a cost function along with a penalty function.

arxiv-2109-13057.creator: Kan Chen 1, Rui Chen 2, Lu Meng 3, Bo Wang 4,5, Shi-Lin Zhu 1

arxiv-2207-07523.title: Approximately Hadamard matrices and Riesz bases in random frames Thanks: Research supported in part by NSF grant DMS 2054408 and by a fellowship from the Simons Foundation.
arxiv-2207-07523.creator: Xiaoyu Dong, Mark Rudelson
arxiv-2207-07523.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyu Dong, Mark Rudelson. An n × n n\times n matrix with ± 1 \pm 1 entries which acts on ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} as a scaled isometry is called Hadamard. Such matrices exist in some, but not all dimensions. Combining number-theoretic and probabilistic tools we construct matrices with ± 1 \pm 1 entries which act as approximate scaled isometries in ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} for all n ∈ ℕ n\in\mathbb{N} .

arxiv-2306-15304.title: GenerTTS: Pronunciation Disentanglement for Timbre and Style Generalization in Cross-Lingual Text-to-Speech
arxiv-2306-15304.creator: Yahuan Cong, Haoyu Zhang, Haopeng Lin, Shichao Liu, Chunfeng Wang, Yi Ren, Xiang Yin, Zejun Ma
arxiv-2306-15304.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yahuan Cong, Haoyu Zhang, Haopeng Lin, Shichao Liu, Chunfeng Wang, Yi Ren, Xiang Yin, Zejun Ma. Cross-lingual timbre and style generalizable text-to-speech (TTS) aims to synthesize speech with a specific reference timbre or style that is never trained in the target language. It encounters the following challenges: 1) timbre and pronunciation are correlated since multilingual speech of a specific speaker is usually hard to obtain; 2) style and pronunciation are mixed because the speech style contains language-agnostic and language-specific parts.

arxiv-2308-03969.title: Closure Relations of Synchrotron Self-Compton in Afterglow stratified medium and Fermi-LAT Detected Gamma-Ray Bursts 2015 Closure Relations of Synchrotron Self-Compton in Afterglow stratified medium and Fermi-LAT Detected Gamma-Ray Bursts – 3
arxiv-2308-03969.creator: Nissim Fraija, Maria G. Dainotti, B. Betancourt Kamenetskaia, D. Levine, A. Galvan-Gamez
arxiv-2308-03969.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nissim Fraija, Maria G. Dainotti, B. Betancourt Kamenetskaia, D. Levine, A. Galvan-Gamez. The Second Gamma-ray Burst Catalog (2FLGC) was announced by the Fermi Large Area Telescope (Fermi-LAT) Collaboration. It includes 29 bursts with photon energy higher than 10 GeV. Gamma-ray burst (GRB) afterglow observations have been adequately explained by the classic synchrotron forward-shock model, however, photon energies greater than 10 GeV from these transient events are challenging, if not impossible, to characterize using this afterglow model.

arxiv-2311-08553.title: Emission of twisted photons by a Dirac electron in a strong magnetic field
arxiv-2311-08553.creator: I. Pavlov, D. Karlovets
arxiv-2311-08553.description: Abstract We study spontaneous emission of a photon during the transitions between relativistic Landau states of an electron in a constant magnetic field that can reach the Schwinger value of H c = 4.4 × 10 9 H_{c}=4.4\times 10^{9} T.

arxiv-2401-01815.title: On properties of the distribution of virtual wormholes in a vacuum
arxiv-2401-01815.creator: A. A. Kirillov, E. P. Savelova
arxiv-2401-01815.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. A. Kirillov, E. P. Savelova. A model of space-time foam in the form of an arbitrary distribution of spherical Euclidean wormholes is considered. A method for constructing the exact solution of Einstein’s Euclidean equations for the metric corresponding to this model is proposed. In the framework of our model we obtain the expression for the Euclidean action and its dependence on the parameters of wormholes in the explicit form.

arxiv-2411-09610.title: One or two poles for the Ξ ⁡ ( 1820 ) \Xi(1820) ?
arxiv-2411-09610.creator: E. Oset
arxiv-2411-09610.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by E. Oset. In this talk, we present a new interpretation for the recently observed Ξ ⁡ ( 1820 ) \Xi(1820) resonance. We recall that the chiral unitary approach for the interaction of pseudoscalar mesons with the baryons of the decuplet predicts two states for the Ξ ⁡ ( 1820 ) \Xi(1820) resonance, one with a narrow width and the other one with a large width.

arxiv-2508-09976.title: Masquerade: Learning from In-the-wild Human Videos using Data-Editing
arxiv-2508-09976.creator: Marion Lepert, Jiaying Fang, Jeannette Bohg, [0.1cm] Stanford University[2pt] https://masquerade-robot.github.io, [2pt]
arxiv-2508-09976.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marion Lepert, Jiaying Fang, Jeannette Bohg, [0.1cm] Stanford University[2pt] https://masquerade-robot.github.io, [2pt]. Robot manipulation research still suffers from significant data scarcity: even the largest robot datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and less diverse than those that fueled recent breakthroughs in language and vision. We introduce Masquerade, a method that edits in-the-wild egocentric human videos to bridge the visual embodiment gap between humans and robots and then learns a robot policy with these edited videos.

pmc-11313053.title: Cr–Diamond/Cu Composites with High Thermal Conductivity Fabricated by Vacuum Hot Pressing
pmc-11313053.creator: Qiang Xu, Xiaodie Cao, Yibo Liu, Yanjun Xu, Jiajun Wu
pmc-11313053.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chromium-plated diamond/copper composite materials, with Cr layer thicknesses of 150 nm and 200 nm, were synthesized using a vacuum hot-press sintering process. Comparative analysis revealed that the thermal conductivity of the composite material with a Cr layer thickness of 150 nm increased by 266%, while that with a Cr layer thickness of 200 nm increased by 242%, relative to the diamond/copper composite materials without Cr plating.

pmc-11452657.title: Developing a workflow for the isolation of hybridoma cells producing fully human antigen-specific antibodies using a surface IgG detection method
pmc-11452657.creator: Hiroyuki Satofuka, Yayan Wang, Hiroshi Tanaka, Kei Hiramatsu, Kayoko Morimoto, Haruka Takayama, Haochen Tu, Yu Qiao, Satoru Ito, Xu Gao, Mitsuo Oshimura, Yasuhiro Kazuki
pmc-11452657.description: The antigen-mediated B cell isolation method, based on the detection of surface IgG (sIgG), has increased the efficiency of therapeutic antibody (Ab) discovery. However, the reduction in sIgG expression on B cells during plasma cell differentiation presents challenges as it enables Ab production from only a small subset of B cells (e.g., memory B cells).

pmc-11528123.title: Personalized bioceramic grafts for craniomaxillofacial bone regeneration
pmc-11528123.creator: Ana Beatriz G. de Carvalho, Maedeh Rahimnejad, Rodrigo L. M. S. Oliveira, Prabaha Sikder, Guilherme S. F. A. Saavedra, Sarit B. Bhaduri, Debby Gawlitta, Jos Malda, Darnell Kaigler, Eliandra S. Trichês, Marco C. Bottino
pmc-11528123.description: The reconstruction of craniomaxillofacial bone defects remains clinically challenging. To date, autogenous grafts are considered the gold standard but present critical drawbacks. These shortcomings have driven recent research on craniomaxillofacial bone reconstruction to focus on synthetic grafts with distinct materials and fabrication techniques. Among the various fabrication methods, additive manufacturing (AM) has shown significant clinical potential.

pmc-12727879.title: Lightweight super-resolution reconstruction architecture of remote sensing images using a residual hierarchical transformer network
pmc-12727879.creator: Bo Huang, Jian Lin, Qingtang Chen, Yiqing Cao, Liaoni Wu
pmc-12727879.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Remote Sensing image super-resolution technology aims to enhance spatial details, and it is of great significance for the high-quality interpretation of satellite imagery. Recently, Transformer-based models have shown competitive performance in single image super-resolution (SISR). However, current Transformer-based SR approaches often employ window self-attention with fixed small window sizes, limiting the receptive filed to a single scale and preventing the network from gathering multi-scale information such as local textures and repetitive patterns, impeding the model’s ability to remote sensing images.

pmc-13098147.title: Fundamental safety-capability trade-offs in fine-tuning large language models
pmc-13098147.creator: Pin-Yu Chen, Han Shen, Payel Das, Tianyi Chen, Derek Abbott
pmc-13098147.description: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on some task-specific datasets has been a primary use of LLMs. However, it has been empirically observed that this approach to enhancing capability inevitably compromises safety, a phenomenon also known as the safety-capability trade-off in LLM fine-tuning.
